sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins and a draw, establishing a commanding lead in the division. Alsager Town sit rock-bottom with just 4 points and are winless in their last five games, making this a heavily favoured encounter for the hosts.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town face a tough away trip to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between strong sides — Bridgnorth have won four of their last five while Eccleshall have recovered well from a recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals, sitting fourth, visit Wednesfield Community in a contest between mid-table rivals. Bilston Town (6th, in-form) travel to Foley Meir seeking another victory, while Barnton host Shawbury United — Barnton are mid-table but Shawbury are struggling near the bottom with five consecutive defeats. New Mills, inconsistent this season, visit Market Drayton Town in a lower-half clash. Brereton Social host Widnes Town at the foot of the table; Widnes are pointless from 7 games while Brereton have won their last outing. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a mid-lower-table battle. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's weakest performers, with Telford showing slight improvement after recent draws.
